items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Peter had to work like a dog to get me work.

ctx.x: As a result of doing that, has anything come out of it for you?

W: I'm telling you the truth. He said, "It's like you said, you've been away a long time. This is going to help ." I said, "I don't think so." It did circulate my name a great deal because all the write-ups were sensational. But it didn't get me to working night clubs. See, I'm a jazz pianist, a jazz arranger. It didn't work anything that way but it gave me recognition among people that didn't know anything about me, in another field, the ballet, see, that would never come to a night club. But as far as getting…
